summary: Image preview that resolves the way diffusion models do: noise and large blocks sharpen over 30 steps into a scene, different each variation.

events.name: start
events.description: Fires when a generation starts, including the automatic first one. `prompt` is `Mountain dusk`, `Moonlit sea` or `Neon city`.

events.name: done
events.description: Fires when the last denoising step completes.

keyboard.action: In the prompt chips: pick and focus the previous or next prompt, wrapping at the ends; each pick starts a new generation.

accessibility: The prompt chips sit in a `role="radiogroup"` with `aria-label="Prompt"`; each is a native button with `role="radio"` and `aria-checked`, and the checked one is drawn in the accent. Only the checked prompt is in the tab order; arrow keys move the selection.
The status ("Denoising · …", "Done in 2.0s") is an `aria-live="polite"` region; the step counter beside it is plain text.
motion: With reduced motion, each image appears finished at once without the denoising steps.
notes: No model is involved. The three scenes are painted procedurally from a seed, and "New variation" or picking a prompt changes the seed.
The image is a 60 by 40 grid of cells on a 160px tall canvas; a run takes about two seconds and starts automatically on first render.

data.note: The prompts and images are painted procedurally and no model is involved; nothing can be set.
